description: Turns sixteen MIDI CC controllers into control voltages, one per cell of the grid

outputs.text: The value of the CC number printed in the cell above, 0V to 10V across MIDI values 0 to 127; the gamepad driver sends values that reach down to -10V

notes: nothing comes out until a MIDI device is chosen and each cell has been given a CC number
click a cell and move a control on the MIDI device to give that cell the CC number that control sends, or type the number in
the driver, device and channel are picked by left-clicking the three lines of the display, each of which opens a menu of its own; none of them is on the panel's right-click menu
menu: Smooth CC — slews each output towards a new value instead of stepping to it
MPE mode — gives each of the sixteen MIDI channels its own polyphony channel on every output
14-bit CC 0-31 / 32-63 — pairs each CC from 0 to 31 with the one 32 above it, for finer resolution
